keywords.abstract: Synonym for `hollow`: mark a class or method as abstract, requiring a subclass implementation.
keywords.alloc: Allocate a native buffer into a variable by byte count or interop type size.
keywords.arg: Declare a required positional argument inside a `subcommand` body. Consumed in declaration order.
keywords.as: Rename a CLR alias or required export in the current scope.
keywords.band: Bitwise AND over whole numbers or enum members.
keywords.bind: Attach native function bindings to a required native module.
keywords.bnot: Bitwise complement of a whole number.
keywords.bor: Bitwise OR. Combines members of a `flags` enum.
keywords.callconv: Override the native calling convention for a bound export.
keywords.catch: Handle a thrown value or runtime failure.
keywords.class: Define a ToSh class with properties, constructors, and methods.
keywords.coerce: Repair clause in a refinement type. `if <guard> coerce <expr>` normalises before validation; a bare `coerce <expr>` fires only after a `where` predicate has failed.
keywords.const: Declare a constant value. Reference it later as `$name`. Cannot be reassigned.
keywords.contains: Membership operator: returns true when the right operand is contained in the left.
keywords.continue: Skip the rest of the current loop iteration.
keywords.defer: Schedule a block to run when the enclosing scope exits, even on exception or early return.
keywords.eager: Subcommand modifier: run this body even when dispatch descends into a child. Used for setup work. Cannot combine with `hollow`.
keywords.ends-with: String predicate: returns true when the left value ends with the right value.
keywords.enum: Define a named enum with symbolic members and optional underlying numeric storage.
keywords.event: Declare an event that handlers can subscribe to via `handles`.
keywords.export: Export a module declaration or environment variable.
keywords.extend: Add methods to an existing type; `$this` is the receiver.
keywords.extends: Declare that a class derives from a base class.
keywords.fading: Mark a member as deprecated; emits a warning on use.
keywords.fixed: Mark a class property as read-only after initialization.
keywords.flag: Declare an optional named option inside a `subcommand` body. Invoked as `--name value` or `--name=value`; booleans also accept `--no-name`.
keywords.flags: Declare an enum whose members combine; bitwise results keep the enum type.
keywords.fluid: Mark a struct as mutable, allowing field reassignment after construction.
keywords.for: Iterate over pipeline output or another enumerable source.
keywords.from: Select a source file or module in selective `require` forms.
keywords.fulfills: Declare that a class conforms to one or more interfaces.
keywords.func: Define a function. Use `func name(args) { ... }` or `func name => command`.
keywords.get: Getter body inside a `prop` declaration. Also the pipeline command that projects members, aliased as `pick` and `select`.
keywords.global: Publish a declaration to the session-wide scope.
keywords.guarded: Restrict member access to the defining class and its subclasses (protected).
keywords.handles: Register a handler block for a named event.
keywords.has: Whether every bit of the right flag is set in the left value.
keywords.hermit: Mark a class as static-only; all members are auto-promoted to shared.
keywords.hidden: Subcommand modifier: exclude from auto-generated help and "did you mean" suggestions. Still fully callable.
keywords.hollow: Mark a class or method as abstract, requiring subclass implementation.
keywords.if: Run a block when a condition evaluates to true.
keywords.implements: Synonym for `fulfills`: declare that a class implements one or more interfaces.
keywords.interface: Define an interface: a set of method/property signatures classes can fulfill.
keywords.is-in: Membership operator: returns true when the left value is in the right collection.
keywords.lazy: Defer property initialization until first access.
keywords.leaky: Mark a struct as having reference-like (leaked) semantics.
keywords.let: Bind a name in a pattern-match arm or comprehension.
keywords.local: Restrict member visibility to the defining assembly (internal).
keywords.match: Use `match (<value>) { pattern => result; default => fallback }` for expression-style branching, or `match <regex> ...` as the regex command.
keywords.module: Define a named ToSh module object with its own lexical scope.
keywords.nameof: Return the name of a variable or member path.
keywords.native: In `require native`, load a native shared library for binding and invocation.
keywords.new: Construct a CLR object, ToSh named type, or shell collection type like `new list<String>(...)`.
keywords.obsolete: Synonym for `fading`: mark a member as deprecated; emits a warning on use.
keywords.once: Limit an event handler so it fires at most one time.
keywords.out: Mark a native binding parameter as output-only and return its updated value after the call.
keywords.override: Synonym for `overrule`: override an inherited method from a parent class.
keywords.overrule: Override an inherited method from a parent class.
keywords.partial: Allow a class definition to be split across multiple declarations.
keywords.priority: Set the dispatch priority for an event handler.
keywords.private: Synonym for `shy`: hide a class member from outside the class.
keywords.prop: Declare a class property, getter, setter, or computed member.
keywords.protected: Synonym for `guarded`: restrict access to the defining class and its subclasses.
keywords.proud: Explicitly mark a member as public.
keywords.public: Explicitly mark a member as public (no-op, members are public by default).
keywords.quote: Capture an expression as an unevaluated quoted form for macro/rune use.
keywords.raw: Mark a method for unsafe/native interop.
keywords.readonly: Synonym for `fixed`: mark a class property as read-only after initialization.
keywords.record: Define a named data shape with positional construction, defaults, and structural equality.
keywords.ref: Mark a native binding parameter as by-reference so the call can read and update it.
keywords.require: Load a `.tosh` module, `.dll`, or `.csproj` once per session and import names lexically.
keywords.required: On an `event`, callers must handle it; on a property, a synonym for `vital`.
keywords.return: Exit the current function or script early.
keywords.rune: Define a macro-like expansion that runs at parse time.
keywords.sealed: Prevent a class from being inherited.
keywords.set: Setter body inside a `prop` declaration. The incoming value is bound to `$value`.
keywords.shared: Mark a class member as belonging to the class instead of an instance (alias for static).
keywords.shy: Keep a declaration in the current lexical scope, or hide a class member from public inspection and external access.
keywords.starts-with: String predicate: returns true when the left value starts with the right value.
keywords.static: Mark a class member as belonging to the class instead of an instance.
keywords.strict: Make all properties in a class read-only (immutable).
keywords.struct: Define a value-type with positional fields, structural equality, and copy-on-assign semantics.
keywords.subcommand: Declare a named subcommand, turning a script into a structured CLI. Body runs when the user selects it; nest for command trees.
keywords.switch: Legacy statement-style value matching with `case` blocks.
keywords.trait: Define a trait with required and default method/property signatures that classes can adopt via 'uses'.
keywords.type: Define a refinement type: an existing type narrowed by `where` predicates, with optional `coerce` repair. Example: `type Port = int where (_ >= 1 and _ <= 65535)`.
keywords.union: Define a tagged union (sum type) of named variant cases.
keywords.unless: Inverse of `if`: run a block when a condition is falsy. Also valid as a postfix guard on jump statements.
keywords.until: Repeat a block until a condition becomes true.
keywords.uses: Declare that a class adopts one or more traits.
keywords.using: Import CLR namespaces or create CLR aliases in the current lexical scope.
keywords.var: Declare a variable. Reference it later as `$name`.
keywords.vital: Mark a class property as required during construction.
keywords.where: Generic-constraint clause (`where T: Numeric`) or pipeline filter command.
keywords.while: Repeat a block while a condition remains true.
keywords.yield: Emit a value from a generator function or block.

specialVariables.$env: Environment variables by name: `$env.HOME`. Lookup is case-insensitive, and assigning routes through the same export path as `export NAME = "value"`.
specialVariables.$this: Self-reference inside class and struct method bodies.
specialVariables.$tosh: The live ToSh runtime namespace root for config, script state, shell/session state, and host metadata.
specialVariables.$tosh.Function.Args: Arguments passed to the current function (`list`).
specialVariables.$tosh.Function.Input: Pipeline input to the current function.
specialVariables.$tosh.Function.Name: Name of the currently executing function.
specialVariables.$tosh.Host.ProcessId: PID of the current shell process.
specialVariables.$tosh.IsLoginShell: `true` when running as a login shell.
specialVariables.$tosh.Last.Duration: Wall time of the last command (`TimeSpan`).
specialVariables.$tosh.Last.ExitCode: Exit code of the last external process (`int`).
specialVariables.$tosh.Last.Result: Pipeline output of the most recent statement.
specialVariables.$tosh.Script.Name: Filename portion of the running script.
specialVariables.$tosh.Script.Path: Absolute path of the running script file.
specialVariables.$tosh.Session.NextHistoryId: ID that will be assigned to the next history entry.
specialVariables.$value: The incoming value inside a `prop` setter body.
specialVariables._: The current pipeline item in `where`, `each`, and similar contexts.

builtins.flush: Flushes one or more managed file handles. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*

builtins.get-prop: Gets a property value by dynamic name. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Clr`)*

builtins.group-by: Groups pipeline values by a member path, block, or callable. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.group-while: Groups consecutive items while the predicate holds. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.guid: Creates, parses, formats, and inspects GUID values. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Sys`)*
builtins.has-method: Checks whether an object or ToSh class has the named method. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Clr`)*
builtins.has-prop: Checks whether an object has the named property. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Clr`)*

builtins.head: Returns the first objects or first text lines. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*

builtins.repeatedly: Produces an infinite sequence by re-evaluating a block for each item. The block receives the 0-based index. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Functional`)*
builtins.replace: Replaces text in each input value. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*
builtins.reverse: Reverses the order of the current pipeline objects. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.round: Rounds a number to the specified number of decimal places. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Maths`)*
builtins.row: Picks one or more rows from the pipeline by index, range, or list of indices. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.scan: Like reduce but yields every intermediate accumulator value. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.scope: Executes a block and automatically awaits all background jobs started inside it. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Concurrency`)*
builtins.seek: Moves an open managed file handle to a new position and returns the handle for continued piping. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.set-prop: Sets or adds a property on a dynamic record. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Clr`)*
builtins.settle: Executes operations concurrently and returns settled outcomes. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Concurrency`)*
builtins.signal: Sends a signal to a ToSh background job or operating-system process. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Processes`)*
builtins.skip: Skips the first object or first N objects from the pipeline. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.skip-until: Skips input values until the predicate becomes true. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.skip-while: Skips input values while the predicate remains true. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.source: Executes a Tosh script file in the current session and lets it affect the caller scope. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Shell`)*
builtins.spawn: Starts an external command as a background job, or in the foreground with --foreground. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Concurrency`)*
builtins.split: Splits text values into smaller text values. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*
builtins.stat: Returns detailed metadata for one or more paths. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.stdev: Returns the population standard deviation of numeric pipeline values. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.step-by: Takes every Nth item from the pipeline. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.styled: Creates a styled text segment with color and formatting. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Display`)*
builtins.sum: Sums numeric, quantity, storage size, or timespan values. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.summarize: Computes structured summary objects for requested aggregates over the pipeline. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.systemctl: Wraps systemctl, returning typed unit rows for supported list queries and structured unit property sets for supported show and status queries. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Sys`)*
builtins.tail: Returns the last objects or last text lines. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*
builtins.take-until: Yields input values until the predicate becomes true. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.take-while: Yields input values while the predicate remains true. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.tee: Passes values through while also writing them out or capturing them. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.tempfile: Creates a temporary file and returns it as a file system entry. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.template: Renders pipeline objects into text using {{ member.path }} placeholders. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*
builtins.time: Measures the execution time and resource usage of a command or block. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Time`)*
builtins.timeout: Runs an operation with a timeout. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Concurrency`)*
builtins.timespan: Parses a duration into a CLR duration value. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Time`)*
builtins.touch: Creates files or updates access and modification timestamps. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.tr: Translates or deletes characters in text. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*
builtins.transpose: Pivots rows into columns. Each input record's keys become column headers and values become rows. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.tree: Wraps the system tree utility, returning typed tree-entry objects. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.tui: Interactive TUI components for scripts. Provides list pickers, confirmations, text input, file pickers, and custom screens. Use --cli for inline (non-fullscreen) prompts. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Shell`)* **[shell-only]**
builtins.type-of: Returns the CLR type or ToSh class type for each input object. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Clr`)*
builtins.types: Lists available CLR and ToSh shell types. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Clr`)*
builtins.umask: Display or set the file creation mask. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Shell`)*
builtins.uname: Returns kernel and operating system information as a Tosh object. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Sys`)*
builtins.unfold: Generates values from a seed by repeatedly applying a callable. The callable receives the current state and must return a [value, next-state] pair, or null to stop. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Functional`)*
builtins.uptime: Returns system uptime and load averages. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Sys`)*
builtins.variance: Returns the population variance of numeric pipeline values. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.vars: Lists visible variables or opens an interactive variable browser. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Sys`)*
builtins.vec: Builds a Vector from numeric arguments or pipeline input. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Data`)*
builtins.view: Gets or sets shell display preferences. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Shell`)*
builtins.wait-for: Waits for one or more ToSh background jobs to finish. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Processes`)*
builtins.wc: Counts lines, words, bytes, characters, and longest-line length. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*
builtins.where: Filters pipeline objects with a predicate block or callable. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.which: Resolves built-in commands and external executables. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Shell`)*
builtins.window: Yields sliding windows of a given size over the pipeline. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.write: Writes rendered values without a trailing newline. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*
builtins.write-bytes: Writes byte-oriented content to a file, replacing any previous contents. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.write-file: Writes plain text to a file, replacing any previous contents. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.write-line-to: Writes one or more text lines to an open managed text file handle. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.write-to: Writes plain text or bytes to an open managed file handle. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Filesystem`)*
builtins.writeline: Writes rendered values with a trailing newline. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Text`)*
builtins.xargs: Builds command invocations from text input. *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
builtins.zip: Merges two sequences pairwise. The second sequence is the first argument (an array). *(`Tosh.Stdlib.Pipeline`)*
